description: Scores inbound leads by conversion likelihood and syncs enriched records to your CRM. Returns each lead with a score (0–100), tier (hot/warm/cold), and enrichment data.

crm_push.description: If true, syncs scored results to your connected CRM. Defaults to true.

leads.description: Array of lead objects. Each must have at minimum an 'email' field. Optional: name, company, phone, source.

score_model.description: Scoring model to use. Options: 'default', 'b2b', 'saas', 'real_estate'. Defaults to 'default'.

name: yax_score_leads

crm_synced.description: True if results were pushed to CRM.

leads.description: Scored and enriched lead records with score (0–100), tier (hot/warm/cold), and enrichment fields.

ok.description: True if the workflow ran successfully.
